description: Renovate posture for rackctl/docs. The org preset github>rackctl/.github supplies the shared posture: the three-day release-age floor, vulnerability alerts that skip it, the weekly schedule, digest-pinned actions, lock file maintenance, and the @shuttering registry credentials. Only what is specific to this Astro + Starlight site is stated here.

TITLE CONTRACT: the preset's titles are chore(deps): — 'deps' is the semantic SCOPE, never the TYPE. The repo's history is conventional (ci(deploy):, fix(docs):, docs(configuration):); a 'deps:' type would sit outside the conventional set.

ORDERING: these packageRules are appended after the preset's, and later rules win. None sets automerge or minimumReleaseAge, so the preset's no-automerge stance and age floor hold for every rule below.

packageRules.description: Astro and Starlight move as ONE PR. @astrojs/starlight declares a peer range on astro, so bumping astro across a major without starlight, or the reverse, produces a lockfile that cannot resolve. Separate PRs would each be green in isolation and break on merge order.

description: The @shuttering/* packages resolve from npm.pkg.github.com (see .npmrc). Pinned exact: this is a private design system, a bump can change how every page renders, and a caret is what let a broken theme version sit installed while a fix was already published. An exact pin forces a visible PR.
npmjs carries this scope too, but behind. A version this repo cannot see is a credential problem, never a reason to repoint the registry.

packageRules.description: Typefaces are content, not behaviour: a fontsource bump changes glyph files, never an API. Minor and patch bumps share one PR.
Biome is pinned to an exact version: the lockfile, not a range, is what makes CI's lint gate reproducible. Renovate still moves that pin, visibly and on its own.
